grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: Yes/No questions with it's
grammarPoints.rule: Ask 'Is it a/an + noun?' to guess what something is. Answer 'Yes, it is.' or 'No, it isn't.' Use 'It's a/an + noun' to say what something really is.
grammarPoints.pattern: Is it a/an + noun? Yes, it is. / No, it isn't. It's a/an + noun.

intro_examples.text: Is it a crayon? No, it isn't. It's a pen.
intro_examples.jp: それはクレヨンですか？いいえ、違います。それはペンです。

intro_examples.text: Is it a map? Yes, it is. It's a map.
intro_examples.jp: それは地図ですか？はい、そうです。それは地図です。

intro_examples.text: Is it a clock? No, it isn't. It's a computer.
intro_examples.jp: それは時計ですか？いいえ、違います。それはコンピューターです。

rules.title: Ask with Is it a/an...?
rules.subtitle: Put 'Is it' before 'a' or 'an' plus the object's name to ask what something is.
rules.jp_subtitle: 何かが何であるかを尋ねるときは、'Is it' の後に 'a' か 'an' と物の名前を続けます。

rules.title: Answer Yes with Yes, it is.
rules.subtitle: If the answer is correct, say 'Yes, it is.' Don't shorten it to 'Yes, it's.'
rules.jp_subtitle: 答えが正しいときは 'Yes, it is.' と言います。'Yes, it's.' には短縮しません。

rules.title: Answer No with No, it isn't.
rules.subtitle: If the guess is wrong, say 'No, it isn't.' and then give the correct object with 'It's a/an...'
rules.jp_subtitle: 推測が間違っているときは 'No, it isn't.' と言い、その後 'It's a/an...' で正しい物を伝えます。

grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: What and How many
grammarPoints.rule: Ask 'What is it?' to name an object and 'What color is it?' to ask its color. Ask 'How many + plural noun?' to ask an amount, and answer with just the number.
grammarPoints.pattern: What is it? It's a/an + noun. / What color is it? It's + color. / How many + plural noun? + number.
